## DPDP Act 2027 Privacy & Zero-Snooping Pledge
Super Telecom is fully compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2027:
- **Zero-Snooping Workshop Guarantee:** Technicians never require lock-screen passcodes for hardware repairs (screens, batteries, charging ports) and strictly never open or access customer photo galleries, chats, or personal files.
- **Right to Erasure:** Customers can request complete deletion of their repair job history and phone number anytime with immediate processing.
- **Data Protection & Grievance Officer:** Barganda Road, Near Shivam Clinic, Giridih - 815301. Contact: supertelecom1002@gmail.com / +91 80029 03643. SLA: 7 working days.

## Super Telecom Native Android App Suite (4-Engine Architecture)
- **Showcase URL:** https://www.supertelecom.shop/app
- **Package ID:** com.supertelecom.app (Version 2.4.0, 1.69 MB)
- **Monetization:** 100% Free, Zero Ads, Zero Subscriptions
- **Compliance:** DPDP Act 2027 On-Device Guarantee (Zero remote telemetry, zero cloud uploads)
- **Engine 1 - Super Transfer:** High-speed offline Wi-Fi Direct and local hotspot P2P file sharing with 64KB bounded socket buffers (supports 4GB+ 4K videos without memory bloat), 6-digit PIN & QR pairing, and client-side SHA-256 verification.
- **Engine 2 - Super Recover:** Honest 4-tier on-device media recovery engine scanning accessible MediaStore trash and user-authorized Storage Access Framework (SAF) folders without root exploits. Transparently respects Android 10+ File-Based Encryption (FBE) limits.
- **Engine 3 - Super Launcher:** Custom clean home screen launcher implementing RoleManager.ROLE_HOME with 4 instant themes (Super Minimal, Super iOS-Inspired, Super Pixel-Inspired, Super Classic) and a prominent 1-tap 'Restore Original Launcher' safeguard.
- **Engine 4 - Home & Lab Dashboard:** Bilingual (Hindi + English) system diagnostics and verified Giridih lab contacts.
